SV-11240.note: Raised by us from our three report cases, which can only be judged by reading the Google Analytics reports (QA has no access). Our closing comment (12 Oct) says the events were checked and passed for the default/saved split and the weekly-use counts; the reports themselves belong to Milos in Google Analytics, so nothing is needed from engineering. No new case.
SV-11240.summary: Work Orders Analytics – Report Checks Blocked Without Google Analytics Access

SV-11128.note: Raised from our C96960. The fixed behaviour (a line whose technician is there only because of a Schedule shift follows the new lead; the shift technician stays on the line's list; PRD S4-R8 context note, v46) is now checked by C581891 Steps 7 and 9. QA passed 13 Oct.
SV-11128.summary: Board View – line technician doesn't follow new lead when shift scheduled

SV-11126.note: Raised from our C368136. The fix (a shift made with the Schedule's "Entire work order" option brings up the "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt; PRD S4-R28, v47) is checked by C368133 Step 4 (prompt opens for the whole-work-order shift) and Steps 6 to 10 (no prompt for a shift on some lines only, an ended shift or another person's shift); C368136 checks the prompt on Board View and Tech View, drag and dialog. QA passed 13 Oct.
SV-11126.summary: Board View – no "Clear shifts" prompt when outgoing lead has a work order shift

SV-11125.note: Outside WO Board and Tech View: Parts > Returns > Credits, from the developer's regression list. It came from our regression case C368221, which the QA lead deleted on 12 Oct. QA passed it on 19 Oct: the 60-day filter is kept after a reload (the check the ticket came from), and opening on Returns is how production works. Nothing to add.
SV-11125.summary: Returns – Reload Goes Back to the Returns Tab Instead of Credits

SV-11124.note: The Staff list has no photo column on production either and the PRD does not ask for one, so its expected result (photos in the Staff list) is not a requirement. It came from our regression case C368242, deleted by the QA lead on 12 Oct. The real regression check, a new photo shows after a reload, is still checked by C368241 (top bar), C368243 (Schedule) and C368244 (Board View). QA passed 19 Oct.

SV-11123.note: Outside WO Board and Tech View: the Part Sales page, from the developer's regression list. It came from our regression case C368216, which the QA lead deleted on 12 Oct. C368215 still checks that the part sale's status card shows a Sales Representative field (a dropdown on an Estimate). Saving a changed person and keeping it after a reload has no case now; QA passed that on staging on 19 Oct. Ask the QA lead if he wants that check back.
SV-11123.summary: Part Sale – Status Card Has No Technician or Sales Representative Field

SV-11122.note: Raised from our regression case C368181 (an asset's Work Orders tab count matches its rows), which is still in the suite. The ticket was closed as OBSOLETE because it duplicates SV-11110 ("Asset page – Work Orders tab shows no count while Invoices does", Ready to Fix), which carries the defect. No new case; C368181 keeps checking it.
SV-11122.summary: Asset Page – Work Orders Tab Shows No Count

SV-11121.note: The behaviour was dropped: PRD v48 (13–14 Oct) removed Imported from the lead-technician lock (S4-N2) and made Imported work orders List-only (S1-R13a). QA passed on 19 Oct (no Lead technician on the Imported page, same as production). Its source case C368247 was deleted. The List-only rule is checked by C154648 and C581896.
SV-11121.summary: Imported Work Order – Page Shows No Lead Technician at All

SV-11120.note: The PRD only says the lead technician cannot be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid (Key Decisions); it does not ask for a greyed-out field. C96963 Step 10 checks that the lead of an Invoiced work order cannot be changed on the work order page, and the case covers Paid on the board. Source case C368165 was deleted 12 Oct. QA passed 19 Oct (plain text, same as production).
SV-11120.summary: Paid Work Order – Lead Technician Shows as Plain Text, Not a Disabled Field

SV-11119.note: No case checks two people reordering the same technician at once. It was raised from our C368149, which was deleted on 12 Oct; C97005 checks only that one person's saved order is shared, and quotes the old S9-R11 wording. Missing check: two browsers, the same column Alpha, Mid, Zeta; person 1 moves Zeta to the top, person 2 (without refreshing) moves Mid to the top; after both refresh, both show Mid, Zeta, Alpha with no warning. Ticket's own words (PRD v65 S9-R11, quoted in the 19 Oct comment): "Each drop saves only the card that was moved, so neither person's move is erased... after a refresh both see Mid, Zeta, Alpha." Ticket is still In Progress and FAILED on 19 Oct.
SV-11119.summary: Board View – Two People Reordering the Same Technician: the Later Save Does Not Win

SV-11118.note: Its expected result came from the QA handoff test plan, but the PRD keeps List exactly as production (§1 Business Case), and production behaves the same way. QA passed on 19 Oct as not a fault. Source case C368204 was deleted by the QA lead on 12 Oct. Nothing in the PRD asks for this, so no case.
SV-11118.summary: Work Orders – Top Menu Keeps a Link's Tab and "Assigned to me" Instead of the Saved View

SV-11117.note: Raised from our C96983. The fixed behaviour (after a failed settings load the defaults show and the next field choice is saved; PRD S5-N2, S5-N3) is checked by C96983 Steps 6 to 8 (defaults) and Steps 10 and 11 (the choice made after the failure is still on after a reload). Fix verified 13 Oct.
SV-11117.summary: Board View – Field Choice After a Failed Settings Load Isn't Saved

SV-11107.note: Raised from our C96962. QA passed on 19 Oct: adding a second technician writes no Audit log entry on production either, and S4-R18 only asks to "Continue existing line auditing". C96962 still checks S4-R18 (a technician change made directly in Edit Line adds its own line entry, as today).
SV-11107.summary: Work Order Line – Adding a Second Technician Writes No History Entry

SV-11106.note: Raised from our C96978. The fixed behaviour (a card's Estimated hours is the sum of the lines' estimates with declined lines left out, within 0.1 hours of Total Hours; PRD S5-R11a, v49) is checked by C581894 Steps 4 and 10. Fix verified 13 Oct.
SV-11106.summary: Board View – Estimated Hours Never Shows on a Card

SV-11104.note: Raised from our C368138. QA found it working as expected on 12 Oct. C368138 checks the S4-N11 sentence "The card you dropped this next to has moved. Refresh the board and try again." and, by the QA lead's decision, accepts the extra "Couldn't save the new order. Please try again." headline above it.
SV-11104.summary: Board View – "Card Has Moved" Alert Shows an Extra Headline

SV-11101.note: Raised from our C96929. Closed as a duplicate of SV-11312: under S2-R6 and S9-R14 (PRD v53) a work order that gets its lead after it was made goes to the bottom of that technician's work. C96929 checks that (lead given later) and C674226 checks that a work order made with its lead keeps the List's order; both passed on 19 Oct.
SV-11101.summary: Tech View & Board View – A Technician's Work Orders Don't Start in the List's Default Order (Staging)

SV-11099.note: The PRD changed after this ticket (S1-N1a and S1-N1b): a search alone that matches nothing reads "No work orders match the search "{search}"." with no button; with a filter on it reads "No work orders match these filters" with Clear all filters. C581890 checks the search-only message with no button and C581889 checks the filter message, in Board View and Tech View. Source case C368211 was deleted. QA passed 19 Oct.
SV-11099.summary: Work Orders – Search With No Results Has No "Clear filters" Action

SV-11098.note: Raised from our C96923. Chris corrected S1-E3 in PRD v45 (12 Oct): "Assigned to me stays as the user set it when the location changes, as it does today." C96923 now checks exactly that, and also S1-E2 (the location's default page opens). Passed.
SV-11098.summary: Work Orders – "Assigned to me" Stays On After Changing Location

SV-11087.note: unsure: this fix ships in the separate bugfix release (PR #3619, branch sv11087), not in SV-10043, so it may belong outside this suite. Raised from our C368177, which checks only that the receiving line gets the technician. No case checks the source line. Missing check: after moving a timesheet entry to another line, the source line no longer lists a technician the app added on clock-in, while one added through Edit Line stays at 0.00 h. Chris Ward's ruling in the comments: "When an entry moves to another line, only remove the labor row that clocking in added automatically (SV-8766), and only if the technician has no other time on that line. A technician someone put on the line on purpose (Edit Line) stays there, with 0.00 hours." Plus the claimed-row case: "the line goes back to Unassigned." Ahtasham passed all 6 developer scenarios on 14 Oct.
SV-11087.summary: Lines tab – timesheet line change leaves technician on the source line

SV-11075.note: Raised from our C96938. The fixed behaviour (S2-R10: "Hovering a technician header or avatar reveals the technician's name.") is checked by C96938, which hovers both the header name and the avatar, including a long name. QA passed 12 Oct.
SV-11075.summary: Tech View – technician avatar in group header has no name tooltip

SV-11074.note: Raised from our C96968 and C97010. The fixed behaviour (a move that cannot be saved goes back, shows "Failed to update lead technician, please try again." and the lead stays unchanged; S9-N2, S4-N3, S4-N8) is checked by C96968 (offline reassign: the exact alert, the lead unchanged after a reload) and C97010 Steps 9 to 14. QA passed 12 Oct.
SV-11074.summary: Board View – drag made while offline isn't reverted and is saved on reconnect

SV-10985.note: A server-side fault (a database lock left held after a request crashes on a persistent connection). A manual tester cannot cause it, QA's database connection is not persistent, and it has never been seen in production; the developer proves the fix on the server stack. The tester-visible alert it could produce ("The board is busy with another move. Please try again.", S4-N12) is already checked by C368139.
SV-10985.summary: Work Orders board: a crashed request can leave a column's drop lock held

SV-10984.note: A performance task (a 2-letter search on the board takes about 450 ms on the server against 200 ms for the List), measured by developers on a 9,000-work-order location. A manual tester cannot measure server timing. Its second "done when" point, board and List search results stay identical (S1-R11), is already checked by C96914.
SV-10984.summary: Work Orders board: a short text search is about twice as slow as the List's
